title: Yapi: AutoBark
description: Automatically generates Farmer's Delight cutting-board bark recipes for modded logs and wood blocks.
body: # YAPI Auto Bark > Automatically generates Farmer’s Delight bark cutting recipes for modded wood sets. ## About YAPI Auto Bark is a lightweight compatibility mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge modpacks using **Farmer’s Delight**. The mod automatically scans loaded blocks and generates cutting-board recipes for: * logs * wood blocks * stems * hyphae * bark blocks * other axe-strippable wooden variants Instead of requiring every wood mod to manually add Farmer’s Delight recipes, Auto Bark generates a runtime datapack and keeps it synchronized with the installed mod list. When compatible blocks are processed on a Farmer’s Delight cutting board using an axe, they produce: * the stripped block * Farmer’s Delight tree bark ## Features * Automatically detects axe-strippable wood blocks * Generates Farmer’s Delight cutting-board recipes at runtime * Supports most modded wood sets without hardcoded integrations * Manual override support for unsupported edge cases * Automatic datapack regeneration when mods or configs changeBuilt-in Brazilian Expansion compatibility mappings * Lightweight and server-friendly ## Supported Blocks Auto Bark can generate recipes for: * Logs * Wood blocks * Stems * Hyphae * Bark blocks * Other axe-strippable wooden blocks The system uses Minecraft’s axe-stripping registry and additional compatibility logic to infer valid mappings automatically. ## Configuration Generated datapacks are stored in: \`\`\`txt config/yapi\_autobark/ ## Community Follow the development of the mod, share ideas, and stay updated here: **YouTube:** [https://www.youtube.com/@YAPILabs](https://www.youtube.com/@YAPILabs) **Discord:** [https://discord.gg/KYGyy9jFCz](https://discord.gg/KYGyy9jFCz)
